subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Projection Bias
description: A quick win: understand Projection Bias.

hook.text: Shoppers who grocery-shop while hungry buy 64% more junk food. They project current hunger onto future meals.

buildup.text: Projection bias means assuming your future preferences will match your current ones.

discovery.text: Loewenstein showed people overestimate how long current feelings will last. Happiness fades; misery fades.

twist.text: Gym memberships spike in January when motivation is high. By March, the mood fades but the contract remains.

climax.text: Before a big decision, ask: will I still feel this way in six months? If unsure, delay or add a cancellation option.

punchline.text: Today's feeling is a terrible forecast of tomorrow.

quiz.question: What is projection bias?
options: Projecting your feelings onto other people
Assuming future preferences will match current ones
